Constraint: Responsibilities shall be separated into Decision Management (Control Plane), Decision Delivery/Distribution, and Decision Execution (Data Plane).
Published runtime artifacts shall be immutable.
Production Runtime nodes shall be horizontally scalable and stateless with respect to client sessions/long-running process state.
Runtime shall use local/in-memory access to eligible artifacts on the critical execution path; Control Plane must not be a synchronous dependency for normal evaluation.
Artifact synchronization shall be event/desired-state driven or use an equivalent mechanism that satisfies <=2s convergence and no-restart delivery.
Decision composition shall remain synchronous deterministic DAG-based decision orchestration and shall not expand into BPM/long-running workflow orchestration.
Technology choices such as Kafka, Redis, CQRS, a DMN engine, database product, reverse proxy or cache product require ADR justification and are not fixed by this SRS.
